nom: Clinique Daily Calm Gentle Cream Face Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: a couple feel it doesn't cut through oil enough and wouldn't recommend it for oily skin, while a reviewer with oily-leaning combination skin found it calming and non-irritating.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers consistently describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, several noting it avoids the post-wash tightness they get from foam cleansers, and one reports it even helped reduce dryness and acne around her nose.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin says it left her skin hydrated and calm, with no breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea or a compromised barrier, overwhelmingly report no irritation, redness reduction and comfortable daily use, though a couple note it doesn't remove all dirt and oil as thoroughly as they'd like.
segments.normal: One reviewer lists it as a good option for normal, dry, or sensitive skin.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her mid-50s with dry, sensitive, mature skin switched to this from makeup-melting balms, saying it cleans without the greasy feel and leaves skin soft rather than stripped.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across dry, sensitive and combination skin, report the cleanser leaves skin feeling clean and moisturized rather than tight or stripped, including several who say it solved the post-cleanse tightness they got from foaming washes.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones with rosacea, report visibly reduced redness and calmer-looking skin with regular use; one notes she didn't see a big reduction during a summer of extra sun exposure but still felt less irritated overall.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with a compromised or reactive skin barrier report the cleanser helped repair or calm it rather than strip it further, describing it as safe for an already irritated barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers, including some who are acne- or breakout-prone, consistently report no new breakouts, and one specifically saw noticeably less acne around her nose.
concerns.oiliness: The cleanser doesn't leave an oily residue for most reviewers, but a couple with oily skin feel it doesn't cut through excess oil and daily grime thoroughly enough for their skin.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't foam or lather, feels less deep
Doesn't fully remove heavy or waterproof makeup
Pricey, and a tube may not last long

extraits.texte: As someone with oily skin I was not wowed by this product. I liked that it had no scent, but it didn't feel like it was truly cleansing my face and stripping my oils. I used it morning and night and still never felt that much of a difference. I wouldn't recommend this to other people with oily skin because you'd probably want something that really gets in there and cleanses. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes

I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes. This cleanser is very gentle and non-drying. I have oily skin, so I am not sure that I would purchase this product as I prefer more of a deep clean of my skin. This would be great for those with dry skin who want to retain more moisture and don't have as much oil to wash off at the end of the day.

extraits.titre: Clean, soft skin without the greasy feel of balms
extraits.texte: I am in my mid-50s with dry, mature skin that tends to be sensitive. I use this cleanser at night to remove my makeup and wash away the oil and grime of the day. My skin feels clean and soft afterward instead of tight or stripped. The texture itself is light, smooth, and spreads easily across the skin without feeling heavy or filmy. I also use it on my eyelids and see no irritation, and there is no odor at all. I typically use IT Cosmetics Bye Bye Makeup or the Drunk Elephant Makeup Melting Butter for makeup removal, but I think I am going to switch to this Clinique cleanser after using it for two weeks. It gets the job done without being greasy, unlike those other balms, and it is also much easier to rinse off. It is also not as thick as Pond's can be. It is comparable in pricing to the IT Cosmetics and Drunk Elephant options, a bit less expensive, but the feel on my skin is so much better. I am really impressed with this cleanser. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

As someone who has rosacea, I have noticed the redness on my cheeks has been significantly reduced since I have started using Clinique's Daily Calm™ Gentle Cream Cleanser. I use it at night to remove my makeup and wash away the day. Unlike other cleansers, this one does not foam. It has more of a creamy consistency and left my skin feeling moisturized and clean. It did not leave my skin dry or tight which is really important for keeping my skin looking calm. I LOVE that this is fragrance free as that is usually one ingredient that causes irritation. Sometimes it is difficult to find a cleanser that doesn't include fragrance. It is a little pricy, but it is worth a shot if you are struggling with sensitive skin. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

This cleanser truly is a gentle cleanser. After use it doesn't leave the skin feeling tight or stripped of all moisture. Certainly this is gentle for sensitive skin types. There is no fragrance. It doesn't foam at all. Rubs into the skin easy and then wipes off just as easy too. Since it is super gentle don't expect this to clean any pores or get off any heavy makeup. I used this product more as an everyday cleanse in the morning and night. I was having skin barrier issues and using this cleanser in combo with the cream was great for repairing it! I would totally recommend if looking for something gentle for everyday use. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this face wash! I have struggled for so long to find something that works for my skin. I struggle with dry skin and acne particularly around my nose, and I wouldnt have thought a face wash not geared towards acne treatment would be what fits for me, but it absolutely does! My face feels less dry and I have a lot less acne around my nose. I am super happy with this product and will be continuing to use it! I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.

Clinique daily calm gentle cream cleanser-I really enjoyed this! I used it in the shower getting ready, when taking my makeup off at night, or as just a refresh from being outside and sweating making my face oily. I've never used a cleanser like this. It surprised me when the directions said to use on dry face and massage all over the face including the eyelids, then wipe off with a damp cloth. No rinsing needed. So simple and easy! I love that it is great for sensitive skin, fragrance free, and it cleansed and hydrated my skin so nicely. Skin felt so soft. My combination skin loved it. I plan to purchase when I run out. I received this product for free from Clinique for testing and review purposes.
